newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean mining output up 25 percent in July.
newsitem.headline: Chilean mining output up 25 percent in July.

text.p: Chilean overall mining production rose 25 percent in July over the same month last year, bringing the rise to 25.8 percent over the 12 months to end-July, the National Statistics Institute.
Higher output of copper, which accounts for over 90 percent weighting in the institute's statistical total, and gold accounted for most of the increase, the figures showed.
Copper production was up 26.8 percent in July and 29.2 percent in 12 months, while gold production was up 27.9 percent and 5.9 percent, respectively, the institute said.
